_comment: Pinned OpenWrt build-pipeline inputs for conwrt cross lanes (mipsel zycast, #109). rust_per_release mirrors lang/rust PKG_VERSION of each openwrt/packages feed branch; audited against the live feed by scripts/sdk_rust_version.py (make openwrt-toolchain-check) - the tollgate-module-basic-go scripts/sdk-go-version.sh pattern. OpenWrt publishes no rust toolchain in released feeds (unlike golang), so feed branches are the only rust authority. openwrt/sdk image digests get pinned here when the #109 docker lane lands.
